name: Serato DJ MCP
description: Lets an AI assistant search and audit a local Serato DJ library: harmonic BPM and Camelot key search, crates, duplicate and missing-file audits, and new crates built with a preview before anything is written. macOS. Unofficial.

SERATO_LIBRARY_PATH.description: Optional path to the Serato library folder (the one holding master.sqlite). Found automatically on macOS when unset.
